snapshot.title: Drone Sighting — Creek Test Area Perimeter

fields.organization: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Security & Campus Safety
fields.location: Creek Test Area, perimeter near gate TP-CTA-LP1 (Birch Hollow Range)
fields.summary: While conducting routine perimeter patrol near the Creek Test Area gate, observed a drone with a red navigation light on top flying in a circular pattern over the Harwick Fairgrounds crowd. Altitude estimated at 200 ft AGL. No visible pilot or ground control station. Sound profile noted as higher than normal for Group aircraft. No Group aircraft were scheduled for flight today, and no operations were active in the area. The observation does not match any feed from HWP-DETECT-01 or GCS-01.

findings.notes: Gate closed, locked, and secured. No signs of forced entry.
Camera not active at time of observation.
No matching signal detected in HUOG-ISP-2026 log for 11:13.
VO on duty at Hangar 1; no alert received.
No Group flight approved for 200 ft AGL over fairgrounds.
No flight session active. No link disruption.
No identifiable pilot or operator observed.
All Group aircraft grounded; no exceptions granted.

actionsTaken: Logged observation in HUOG-ERP-2026 incident log under CR-20261025-111302-0035
Notified Security Lead (SEC) via encrypted channel (GCS-04)
Documented time, location, and visual description for cross-reference with vendor feed
recommendations: Cross-check visual report against HWP-DETECT-01 feed for 11:13
Verify no unauthorized personnel were on-site during patrol window
Flag for review by ASO and SCL for potential spoofing indicators
